summary: Steps can be instructions or docs, name prose sections, and each kind declares its change categories
riskReason: Only adds kinds, a field, and lists; every stored plan still validates, since none uses sections.

add.type: added, removed, renamed, moved, type-changed, nullability-changed, value-changed, behavior-changed, content-changed
Record<StepKind, readonly ChangeCategory[]>, the per-kind lists in docs/model/categories.md; other gets every category

change.from: data-shape, signature-change, behavior-change, feature, non-semantic, other
add, remove, change, unchanged, rules, invariants

change.to: instructions needs sections and at least one rule; docs needs sections
also: each section needs doc and section, and only instructions, docs, and non-semantic steps may have sections

rules.text: an instructions step without sections or without a rule is rejected, naming what's missing
a docs step without sections is rejected
a code-kind step with sections is rejected
every stored plan, #1 to #6, still builds its plan view

evidence: test/steps.test.ts: stores steps through create and edit in a temporary repo and checks each rule
